author: Mark Atwood
text:
Decomposed into four child beads per the reviewer's recommendation:
- .3.1 same-account rejection (smallest fix, largest correctness win — landing first)
- .3.2 ifFromInState / ifInState / fromAccountNotFound
- .3.3 source-id semantics (canonical-template fetch-merge-create pattern from calendars-server)
- .3.4 onSuccessDestroyOriginal implicit Task/set

Note: the reviewer's note that #3 needs a 'copy_task trait reshape touching every other extension server's analog' overstates the workspace cost. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server has a bespoke copy_email signature; jmap-calendars-server uses the generic create_object after fetching source via get_objects. Tasks should follow the calendars pattern, which is a tasks-server-local fix. Same for #4: canonical mail-server emits the implicit second call in the extras channel — no foundation/Dispatcher change required.
